markets.question: Pirelli Italian Grand Prix Main Race Fastest Lap
markets.description: This market will settle to Yes if Lewis Hamilton records the fastest official lap at the Pirelli Italian Grand Prix scheduled for September 6, 2026. If Lewis Hamilton ties with one or more other drivers for the fastest official lap, Yes contract holders receive $1.00 divided by the number of tied drivers, rounded down to the nearest cent, per contract. If Lewis Hamilton is replaced by a reserve or substitute driver between market creation and race start, the market will remain valid and Lewis Hamilton will reference the reserve or substitute driver for purposes of resolution. Outcome sourced from FIA.
